steps.name: 01 Fixture
steps.goal: If a system alert titled Apple Account Verification is showing, tap Not Now to dismiss it. Then wait for the test screen to load.
steps.done: A screen titled OpenCode models and agent updates, with an Open OpenCode models button and an Update all agents row.

steps.name: 02 Open model controls
steps.done: The agent controls tray is open and shows the model GLM 5.3.

steps.name: 03 Router sections
steps.goal: Tap the Model GLM 5.3 control to open the model list. Do not select a model yet.
steps.done: The model list shows short model names under router headings such as OpenCode Go and OpenCode Zen.

steps.name: 04 Lower routers
steps.goal: Inspect the lower part of the model list. Do not select a model yet.
steps.done: The Novita AI, OpenAI and xAI sections are visible.

steps.name: 05 Close tray
steps.goal: Close the model tray. If it is still open, swipe it down or tap the dimmed area above it.
steps.done: The test screen is showing with the Update all agents row, and no model tray.

steps.name: 06 Update running
steps.goal: Tap the Update all agents row once. Then wait. Do not tap it again.
steps.done: The row says it is updating 2 agents, and Codex and OpenCode each show a step such as Installing latest CLI.

steps.name: 07 Update result
steps.goal: Wait for the update to finish. Do not tap anything.
steps.done: The row names the result: 1 of 2 agents failed. Codex says its update failed with an npm error, and OpenCode says it updated from v1.17.6 to v1.17.7.
expect: npm ERR! network request to registry.npmjs.org failed
OpenCode updated from v1.17.6 to v1.17.7
